requested_calendar_clock: 00:00:00 UTC daily; retain absent days explicitly
depth_policy: Require exact provider15m z-level;no vertical interpolation or0-30m average claim.
coordinate_policy: Retain original native1D grid nodes within domain inclusive,with1e-5degree coordinate-representation allowance;no generated boundary cells.
monthly_operator: Equal-weight mean of available daily00Z paired native vectors,using identical timestamps for both components at each cell. Require at leastceil(0.8*calendar days) valid pairs per cell;keep counts and missing/failed cells.
temporal_inference: Monthly means of sampled daily00Z model fields,not full3-hourly monthly means or a climatology.
selection_geometry_role: Fixed acquisition viewport and depth,not current boundary or bathymetric mask.
source_interpretation: Mapped z-level reanalysis model fields;not independent instrument observations or paper reproduction.
